name: Asit C. Mehta Financial Services Limited
about: Asit C. Mehta Financial Services Limited provides advisory and consultancy services on fund mobilization and restructuring of companies in India. It operates through four segments: Investment Activities; Advisory and Consultancy Services; Information Technology Enabled Services (IT); and Stock Broking and Allied Services. The company offers investment advisory and execution; financial planning through Investmentz.com; non-resident indians solutions; plan investments, as well as execute trades in segments and investment vehicles, such as equities, derivatives, commodities, currencies, mutual funds, ETFs, IPOs, OFSs, fixed income instruments, real estate, and alternative investments; and EasyTradez.com, a DIY derivatives trading platform. It also provides institutional services, such as equities, debt, and forex; business process outsourcing services, including KYC documentation, claims, vendor registration, document indexing, record maintenance, loans, and insurance payments; data de-duping; and digital marketing services. In addition, the company is involved in the provision of infrastructure facilities through leasing of vacant properties. Asit C. Mehta Financial Services Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Mumbai, India.
